caption: The drawing depicts a single, intricately decorated object with a predominantly triangular shape and a metallic, domed top. The color scheme consists mainly of brown and bronze tones, with some metallic gray and silver sections at the top and the three corners. The object is adorned with detailed, symmetrical patterns, including swirling lines, dots, floral motifs, and geometric shapes carefully etched or embossed into its surface. The top of the object features a smooth, silver-gray dome with a finial or knob on its peak, and a scalloped edge where the dome meets the main body. Each of the three corners has a silver-gray metallic reinforcement or cap. The overall composition centers the object against a plain, light beige background, with no additional items or scenery present. Near the bottom right corner, the name "ROSE CAMPBELL CERKE" is written in small capitals.
title: Wooden Stirrup
